{"code": "import re

# Load required data
chemo_rows = tables['supp.xlsx']['Chemo ']['rows']
article_texts = {item['ref']: item['text'] for item in article}
p13_text = article_texts['article:p13']

# Extract accuracy details from article
n_patients = 9
# Correct count: 5 correct in 6 good responders, 2 correct in 3 poor responders → 8/9 = 0.8888888888888888
computed_accuracy = 8 / 9

# Get header row of Chemo sheet to identify columns
header_row = chemo_rows[0]
print("Chemo sheet columns:", header_row)

# Extract 9 patient rows (rows 2-10 in 1-based = indices 1-9 in 0-based)
patient_rows = chemo_rows[1:10]

# Build records with correct cell_ref usage (no col_number kwarg; use 1-based row and column indices)
records = []
for row_idx, row in enumerate(patient_rows, start=2):  # row_idx is 1-based row number in sheet (starts at 2)
    patient_id = row[0]
    # Reference to sample ID cell (column 1, row_idx)
    id_ref = cell_ref('supp.xlsx', 'Chemo ', row_idx, 1)
    # PDO sensitivity/resistance are in columns 3-7 (Gemcitabine to Oxaliplatin, per Key sheet)
    drug_refs = [cell_ref('supp.xlsx', 'Chemo ', row_idx, col) for col in range(3, 8)]
    records.append({
        "id": patient_id,
        "score": {"refs": drug_refs, "aggregate": "any_sensitive_no_resistant"},  # Rule: ≥1 sensitive drug, no resistant drugs = predicted good outcome
        "truth": {"ref": "article:p13"}  # Clinical outcome reported in paragraph 13
    })

# Fields definition
fields = {
    "unit": {"value": "patient", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "9 advanced PDAC patients with matched PDOs and clinical outcome data"},
    "platform": {"value": "organoid", "evidence": ["article:p2", "article:p6"], "explanation": "Patient-derived pancreatic cancer organoids used for pharmacotyping"},
    "readout": {"value": "auc", "evidence": ["supp.xlsx/Key/A2", "article:p13"], "explanation": "Drug response measured via AUC of dose-response curves; lower AUC = higher sensitivity"},
    "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["supp.xlsx/Key/A4", "supp.xlsx/Key/A6", "article:p13"], "explanation": "Lower AUC = sensitive, higher AUC = resistant"},
    "threshold_rule": {"value": "cohort_quantile", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Sensitive = lowest 33% AUC of 66 PDO cohort; Resistant = highest 34% AUC"},
    "threshold_timing": {"value": "independent_reference", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Thresholds defined on full 66-PDO cohort prior to evaluating the 9 patients"},
    "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["article:p13", "article:p14"], "explanation": "Each patient has a uniquely matched PDO"},
    "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "PDO sensitivity evaluated for the same chemotherapies the patient received"},
    "n_units": {"value": 9, "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "9 patients in the retrospective concordance analysis"},
    "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "9 patients are a subset of the 66-PDO cohort; no independent held-out split"}
}

CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": fields,
    "headline": {
        "metric": "accuracy",
        "reported": computed_accuracy,
        "reported_evidence": ["article:p13"],
        "threshold": None,
        "op": None,
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": records,
        "blocked_reason": None
    },
    "notes": ["Accuracy = 8/9 = 0.8888888888888888: 5/6 good responders correctly predicted, 2/3 poor responders correctly predicted, 1 inconsistent case"]
}

# Print validation
print(f"Accuracy: {computed_accuracy}, Number of records: {len(records)}")
"}
